scenario.name: r-obs-1
scenario.description: Session-status-card observability via the session_status tool. Creates a disposable session, asks the agent to call session_status, and verifies build/context/continuation-chain/route visibility by nonce-correlated sentinel.

expectedReceipts.name: session-created
expectedReceipts.description: Disposable proof session was created for the status-card read.

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: sessions.send accepted the agent turn that calls session_status.

expectedReceipts.name: status-card-sentinel
expectedReceipts.description: Agent reply included OBS1-STATUS sentinel for the nonce.

expectedReceipts.name: build-context-chain-route-visible
expectedReceipts.description: Sentinel confirms build/version, context usage, continuation chain/queue, and route/delivery context were visible in the status card.

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID from sessions.send or event payload when available.

review.notes: Read-only status-card observability row. PASS-candidate when dispatch is accepted and OBS1-STATUS sentinel reports build/context/chain/route visibility. Candidate artifacts require review before canonical fold.

liveRunSafety.notes: Read-only session_status observability row. Uses a disposable session by default and does not fire continuation tools, delegates, config mutation, restart, or compaction.
